title: Direct RSA Key Pair Generation
description: Tests direct JCA KeyPairGenerator instantiation with algorithm RSA and 2048-bit key size.

expected_findings.evaluation_notes: Scanners must extract RSA and 2048-bit key length. Operational role must be UNKNOWN as KeyPairGenerator does not specify whether keys are used for encryption, signature, or key exchange.

verification_metadata.verification_method: Manual Source Code Inspection & JCA Spec Cross-Check
